user.title: Provider
user.description: Smart LLM connects Home Assistant Assist to a pluggable language model. Cursor uses browser login. The OpenAI menu is OpenAI-compatible and the Anthropic menu is Anthropic-compatible: the official endpoint, or a custom base URL for any compatible host (Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, a local proxy, or an Anthropic-compatible gateway).

menu_option_descriptions.cursor: Sign in with Cursor in your browser, then answer Assist through Cursor Bridge.
menu_option_descriptions.openai: OpenAI-compatible. Official endpoint, or a custom base URL for any compatible host such as Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a local proxy.
menu_option_descriptions.anthropic: Anthropic-compatible. Official endpoint, or a custom base URL for any Anthropic-compatible gateway.
